tasks.title: Add the binding table, lookup, resolver and the AuthorizeWorkspace binding rule in internal/wsaccess
steps: Write TS-33-1, 2, 7, 8 and 17 in internal/wsaccess (and an AuthorizeWorkspace test using an in-memory SQLite DB with SetMaxOpenConns(1)); confirm they fail

Add internal/wsaccess/binding.go with const ErrorTypeTokenBound = "token_bound" and InitBindingSchema(db *sql.DB) error: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS token_workspace_bindings (token_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, slug TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL) and CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_token_workspace_bindings_slug ON token_workspace_bindings(slug); no foreign key
Add LookupBinding(db, tokenID) (slug string, bound bool, err error): one primary-key SELECT; sql.ErrNoRows means unbound, any other error is returned
Add BoundSlug(db, auth) (string, bool, error): only for non-nil auth with CredentialType "pat" and non-empty TokenID; otherwise return "", false, nil without touching db
Close the row (QueryRow().Scan) before returning so no cursor or transaction is open when the lookup runs

In wsaccess.AuthorizeWorkspace, after the existence and ownership checks and before building the result, call BoundSlug; if bound and slug != bound slug return (nil, 404, "workspace not found"); on lookup error return (nil, 500, "internal server error"); admin and non-PAT credentials never reach a query
Run the lookup only after the workspace row has been read and its rows closed (single-connection pools)
Run make test and make lint
done_when: wsaccess still imports only database/sql, net/http, echo and apikit

tasks.title: Add the post-authentication binding guard and the bound-token allowlist registry
steps: Write the ten tests in internal/wsaccess using an echo group with a test auth middleware that reads JSON AuthInfo from X-Test-Auth; confirm they fail
Add internal/wsaccess/allowlist.go: AllowBoundTokens(routes ...*echo.Route) storing Method+" "+Path in a mutex-guarded global map, IsAllowed(method, path string) bool, and a test-only reset helper
Add internal/wsaccess/guard.go: BindingGuard(db *sql.DB) echo.MiddlewareFunc
In the guard: auth := apikit.GetAuthInfo(c); if nil or CredentialType != "pat" call next without any query

If auth.TokenID is empty, parse the Authorization header (scheme Bearer case-insensitive, text between af_pat_ and the next _, non-empty); if none can be derived call next unchanged without a query; otherwise copy the AuthInfo, set TokenID and write it back with apikit.SetAuthInfo
Call LookupBinding once; on error answer apikit.WriteAPIError(c, 500, "internal server error") without calling next; if unbound call next
Bound: if c.Path() contains the consecutive segments workspaces then :slug, compare c.Param("slug") with the bound slug and answer 404 "workspace not found" on mismatch, else call next

Bound and not workspace-scoped: if IsAllowed(c.Request().Method, c.Path()) call next, otherwise apikit.WriteAPIErrorWithType(c, 403, "this token is bound to workspace "+S, ErrorTypeTokenBound); this also covers unmatched paths (route NotFound handler path) and later-registered routes
Run make test and make lint
done_when: a guard installed before any route is registered covers routes and subgroups added later

tasks.title: Add the pre-authentication, deny-only apikit route guard in internal/wsaccess
steps: Write TS-33-30 to 33 in internal/wsaccess; confirm they fail
Add internal/wsaccess/apikit_guard.go: APIKitRouteGuard(db *sql.DB, routes []*echo.Route) echo.MiddlewareFunc; build a set keyed by Method+" "+Path from routes
In the middleware, if c.Request().Method+" "+c.Path() is not in the set call next with no query
Parse the Authorization header (Bearer case-insensitive, af_pat_<id>_...); share the parsing helper with the post-auth guard (extract it to one function). No id means call next with no query

LookupBinding(db, id): on error answer apikit.WriteAPIError(c, 500, "internal server error") and do not call next; bound answers apikit.WriteAPIErrorWithType(c, 403, "this token is bound to a workspace", ErrorTypeTokenBound) without the slug; unbound calls next
Never call apikit.SetAuthInfo, never hash or verify the secret, and import no hashing package
Run make test and make lint
done_when: the guard source imports no hashing or token-verification package
